subject: Pilot billing sequence & VAT routing for Q4 pilot
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orionbio.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Orion Bio AP <ap@orionbio.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot billing request — deposit + extended AP window (VAT evidence)

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to move forward with the Q4 pilot.

One point from our procurement side: Orion consolidates invoices into monthly pay runs and can only commit to Net45 from their AP calendar. For this pilot (anticipated $92k) procurement is asking for: 25% deposit on signature, then the remainder invoiced in two tranches (Net45) aligned to our acceptance milestones.

Separately, AP needs a VAT registration certificate for Redwood's EU entity (or a letter confirming VAT treatment) before they can process the first invoice. I attached a draft order form with the PO fields they expect.

Can Redwood accept Net45 for this initial engagement if we provide a PO and the VAT evidence within 5 business days? If not, what compromise would you recommend — a larger deposit, or a short-term credit hold?

Regards,
Samantha Li
Head of Procurement — Orion Bio
Samantha.Li@orionbio.com

[attachment: draft-order-form.xlsx]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orionbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 12:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot billing request — deposit + extended AP window (VAT evidence)

Hi Samantha — thank you and glad the demo landed well. Looping in Marissa from Finance to help with the payment terms.

High level proposal from Redwood: we can be flexible on the invoice cadence for pilots, but we need to keep credit exposure bounded. Suggested terms that balance both sides:
- 30% deposit (net on signature) — reduces Redwood's exposure immediately.
- 40% milestone invoice (go-live / acceptance) — Net30.
- Remaining 30% split into a final invoice Net30.

So we’d still be on Net30 for milestone invoices, but the larger upfront deposit reduces risk. Alternatively, we can accept Net45 for the post-deposit invoices on a temporary basis up to $75k of exposure, provided:
1) Orion issues an approved PO referencing deal OR-2026-224;
2) We receive the VAT certificate (or confirmation of reverse-charge treatment) before the first non-deposit invoice;
3) AP contacts our billing alias to confirm payment-run date.

If Orion needs Net60 or a longer runway, we’ll require either a larger deposit (50%) or an approved short-term credit line (we can evaluate with underwriting).

Marissa — happy to handoff details if this looks acceptable so you can approve Net45 for this pilot. Samantha — if you can share the PO template and the timeline for VAT cert, we’ll draft an order form.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.inference.com
+1 415-555-0142

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orionbio.com>

Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing request — deposit + extended AP window (VAT evidence)

Thanks, Mateo — that helps. A couple of clarifications from procurement: 
- Orion can increase the deposit to 35% if Redwood can sign Net60 for the remaining invoices (AP consolidation is tight this quarter).
- VAT cert: we’ll provide the buyer-side confirmation if you can confirm Redwood’s billing entity and VAT ID to go on the PO.

If Net60 is a hard stop, we’d prefer a 35% deposit + Net60. Otherwise Net45 with your $75k exposure cap would also work. We’re trying to avoid adding another external credit vendor.

Samantha

Hi Samantha / Mateo — I’m Marissa from Finance — thanks for the clear asks. Some quick notes and what we need to approve a temporary Net45 (or Net60 with additional mitigation):

What we can approve today:
- Temporary Net45 for the two post-deposit invoices up to $75,000 exposure, provided the PO is received and the VAT evidence is submitted no later than 5 business days after signature.

What would be required for Net60:
- 35% deposit on signature;
- A signed credit addendum (short form) and underwriting review (we can complete in 3 business days if you provide a current AP aging and PO history);
- An explicit AP run date on each invoice (helps us trigger reminders).

Checklist for PO/invoicing to avoid holdbacks:
- PO number and billing entity exactly as: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US-EIN: XX-XXXXXXX);
- VAT registration certificate (if Orion expects EU VAT handling) or statement confirming reverse-charge if applicable;
- Billing contact for AP and expected payment-run cadence;
- SOW signed or DocuSign envelope (we can accept DocuSign link).

DocuSign link for our standard order form: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABCD1234

If you confirm you’ll provide PO + VAT cert within 5 business days, we’ll approve Net45 for the pilot and will circulate a short order form for signature. If you need Net60, please confirm willingness to complete the credit addendum — we’ll prioritize the underwriting.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com

Per Marissa’s guidance, Redwood will accept the following for the Q4 pilot (deal OR-2026-224):

- Net45 for the two subsequent milestone invoices (temporary approval up to $75k exposure) once we receive the PO and VAT evidence.
- If Orion requests Net60, Redwood requires a signed credit addendum (we’ll send the template) and 35% deposit.

Next steps:
1) Samantha — please send the PO with billing entity fields as Marissa listed and attach the VAT certificate.
